name: com.yellowstake/agent-desk
title: Agent Desk
description: Checks if a US insurance lead can be called, autodialed or texted now, citing TCPA and state law

tools.name: check_lead_contact
tools.description: Can an insurance agent contact this lead, by manual call, autodialed or prerecorded call, or text, and when? Checks consent (does it name you, cover texts and automation), the National and state Do Not Call rules, state calling hours and call caps, licensed-agent exemptions, Medicare limits and lead-vendor contract windows. Returns go / wait / check / stop per channel with citations. Send one lead, or `leads` (up to 1,000) plus shared `defaults`.

state.description: Two-letter state of the lead, e.g. FL

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP; used when state is missing and cross-checked when both are given

phone.description: The lead's phone number. Places the lead by area code when no state or ZIP is given, and its area code's calling hours also apply

lineType.description: Line type of the number, if you know it

inquiryDate.description: When the lead submitted the form (ISO date)

consentText.description: The exact consent wording the person agreed to

agencyName.description: Your agency name, to check whether the consent names you

consentNamesYou.description: Set if you already know whether the consent names you

onNationalDnc.description: Result of your National Do Not Call scrub, if known

onStateDnc.description: Result of the state Do Not Call scrub, if the state keeps one

lastDncScrub.description: Date of your last registry scrub (ISO date)

onInternalDnc.description: On your internal do-not-call list or opted out

ownLead.description: True if the person contacted your agency directly (not a bought lead)

requestedContact.description: The person asked you to contact them (matters for Medicare)

partnerListIncludesYou.description: The consent names "partners" and your agency is on that linked partner list

lastPurchaseDate.description: Date of the person's last purchase from you, for existing customers (ISO date)

callerIsLicensee.description: The licensed agent is personally making the call (applies OK and IN exemptions)

optedOut.description: The person asked you to stop

certificateClaimed.description: Whether you claimed the TrustedForm or Jornaya certificate

callsLast24h.description: Sales contacts made to this person in the last 24 hours

contactLog.description: ISO times of earlier sales contacts to this person; gives the exact time a call limit reopens

at.description: ISO time to check; defaults to now

tools.name: check_lead_data
tools.description: Check a purchased insurance lead for bad data (invalid or fake phone, placeholder or throwaway email, test names, ZIP outside the claimed state) and get a return request for the lead vendor.

observed.description: What happened when you worked the lead

tools.name: check_outreach_message
tools.description: Check an insurance agent's text, email, call script or voicemail against TCPA, CAN-SPAM, unfair-trade-practice and CMS Medicare marketing rules. Returns what to fix, with citations.

tools.name: state_telemarketing_rules
tools.description: A US state's telemarketing rules for insurance agents: calling hours, Sunday and holiday bans, call caps, state Do Not Call list, automated-call law, call-recording consent and licensed-agent exemptions, each with its citation.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. PA

tools.name: check_calling_window
tools.description: Is a sales call to a person in this US state (or ZIP) inside federal and state calling hours at a given time, and when does it open next?

automated.description: True for autodialed or prerecorded calls

tools.name: insurance_lead_cost
tools.description: Cost per policy and break-even cost per lead for an insurance lead source, from cost per lead, contact rate, quote rate, close rate and first-year commission.

commission.description: First-year commission per policy in USD

tools.name: lookup_phone
tools.description: Look up US phone numbers in NANPA numbering data, refreshed daily: the carrier the number block was assigned to, line type (mobile, landline, VoIP, pager, toll-free), rate center, state and time zone, and whether the exchange or thousands-block is unassigned (a number that cannot be in service). Ported numbers keep their original carrier.
